title: Firebase Storage, media references, thumbnails, and pending uploads

surfaces.currentBehavior: Firebase Storage holds entity-scoped originals and small/medium thumbnails referenced by embedded Firestore URLs. Current rules allow unauthenticated global read/write. iOS has a restart-durable local upload queue; MCP performs privileged copy/upload/delete operations. Object inventory and dangling-reference counts are not yet production-profiled.
surfaces.notes: M2 withheld: A-016/O-023/Canonical production reference/object profile changes or is required to discover the exact target security, data, lifecycle or migration mapping for this source responsibility. Firebase rules/Functions/Admin/Storage mechanics are not provisional target implementation.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Production Storage rules allow every read and write on every object without authentication, account scoping, content-type checks, or size limits.
surfaces.notes: This is a critical legacy security fact, not acceptable target behavior. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; target authority is capability-specific and contains no Firebase application adapter.

securityRequirements: Private object access derives authenticated Account/parent authorization; writes enforce namespace, size, sniffed content/type and service capability with no global or permanent bearer access
syncRequirements: Structured Sync carries stable AttachmentID/reference/status metadata only; protected local bytes/upload queue and authorized resolver own transfer/retry/display

migration.rule: Build stable target attachment/object/reference identities from source Firestore URLs/gs paths/object manifests, preserve source hashes/correlation and quarantine missing/dangling/shared variants.
reconciliation: Every required source reference/object maps to verified target attachment/object, explicit shared/reference state, quarantine or approved omission with counts/byte hashes

surfaces.currentBehavior: Persists pending media bytes and JSON metadata in Application Support/PendingUploads, retries processing up to ten attempts, verifies destination existence, writes URL/thumbnail fields back to dynamically selected Firestore documents, and supports retry or explicit discard.
surfaces.notes: Queue is app-container global with no observed per-user separation or signout cleanup. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; target authority is capability-specific and contains no Firebase application adapter.

securityRequirements: Pending bytes/database/key/cache are encrypted/protected and partitioned by environment, Principal and Account; upload never resumes under another session
syncRequirements: Durable receipt precedes acceptance, retry is idempotent, missing bytes reject visibly and logout/account switch follows explicit pending-work disposition

migration.rule: Import no plaintext app-global queue as authority; recover explicitly approved pending records at cutover and migrate verified attachment metadata/bytes through the object manifest.
reconciliation: Pending/verified/rejected/discarded attachment IDs, byte hashes and operation results balance per local namespace with no silent loss

tests: Atomic enqueue failure, restart/device reboot, account/environment switch, logout dispositions, missing bytes, retry/idempotency and cache/key cleanup tests
acceptance: Every accepted media capture survives offline restart or has an explicit user-approved destructive outcome
